notes.title: 😻 Quilts & Cats of Calico Revealed! A New Board Game Adaptation is Coming 😻
notes.content:
Our upcoming project, Quilts & Cats of Calico, reveals on Steam!

[previewyoutube=gTkhNZk4xQ4;full][/previewyoutube]

Check it out below and add it to your wishlist to stay up to date.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1993180

What is Quilts & Cats of Calico?
Quilts & Cats of Calico is a wholesome digital adaptation of the award-winning puzzle board game Calico for 1-4 players. Your goal is to collect as many points as possible by sewing the best quilt designs that appeal to cute but fussy cats. Pet and customize kitties, play solo or with others and explore the intriguing world where cats come first and people compete with machines!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35583524/948d1e11a4baa05c5b090e372c8efff5b71d48bf.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35583524/08222f6eb05bf3622b4c72a07b2deee7acdc9326.jpg

For some time now, our great ambition has been to create the best board game adaptations. For us, creating a digital version of Wingspan was and still is a great developing adventure full of birds and captivating nature. Quilts & Cats of Calico is the next title of its kind that we will be making after Wingspan. We hope you will be charmed by the cuddly cats of Quilts & Cats of Calico as much as we are.

Last but not least

We also invite you to the Quilts & Cats of Calico Discord server. You’ll find there a sign-up form for the game's beta tests on Steam, about which more information will be coming soon.
